sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-7,200 (levels 1-13). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Develop Queen T1.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 20 to Setup Bishop's impact damage (2.00x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Healing Rite
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healing Nova, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Heroic Aura, 16000 souls (~16.0 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Heroic Aura, 15200 souls (~15.2 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healing Nova, 7200 souls (~7.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healing Nova, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 36 to Setup Bishop's impact damage (2.00x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Kingside Knight: takes 18% off its 17s base cooldown.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 7,200-20,000 (levels 13-25). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Kingside Knight T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Setup Bishop, impact damage) grows from 184 to 265. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Superior Cooldown, vitality 4.8k at Healing Nova, weapon 4.8k at Heroic Aura.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 232s; 20% off is 46.4s per full rotation. Upgrade of Compress Cooldown (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Healing Nova
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Healing Rite (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 8k vitality tier, which Trophy Collector completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Trophy Collector completes 8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Only if your team has gun heroes.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: swap_candidate)

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 20,000-41,600 (levels 25-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rook Battery T3, Develop Queen T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Setup Bishop, impact damage) grows from 265 to 409.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.caption: Silences, disarms and blocks item use on one enemy for 3.25s and strips their non-ultimate buffs, at -25% damage for you and a 55s cooldown: a single-target answer to a buffed carry or engage. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 10,400 to 13,600 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 60 to Setup Bishop's impact damage (2.00x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 13,600 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Upgrade of Guardian Ward (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.
items.legacy_note: Cooldown halves when you cast it on a teammate.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Healing Nova? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.
sections.desc: Dying after Healing Nova? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: They hit you with Knockdown, Slowing Hex or Toxic Bullets.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their team chains stuns and silences on you.

items.name: Knockdown
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Alchemical Fire
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Instead of Heroic Aura when your team has no gun heroes.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Kingside Knight: resets its 17s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 16,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Trophy Collector: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 20,800 to 25,600 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 20,800 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 220s of base cooldown across your kit, 170s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 16,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Enchanter's Emblem: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..
